organic.title: A comparison of in situ and on‐vessel larval rearing for coral seeding
organic.snippet: On-vessel rearing was more costly but supported higher survival, increased portability, and enabled more control and manipulation of rearing conditions.

organic.title: Shading responses are species-specific in thermally stressed corals
organic.snippet: Our results suggest shading during thermal stress may only protect some coral species, highlighting the need to consider species-specific responses.
